newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Cambodian inflation 1.8 percent in April.
newsitem.headline: Cambodian inflation 1.8 percent in April.

text.p: Cambodian inflation was 1.8 percent in April compared with a 0.2 percent fall in prices the previous month, the central bank said in a report on monthly statistics released on Friday.
The Cambodian National Bank said the consumer price index rose to 114.12 in April from 112.12 in March.
The bank attributed the rise in prices to increased purchases over the April new year holiday.
The 12-month moving average inflation rate was 7.2 percent in April, down from 7.4 percent in March, the bank sad.
The bank also said the Cambodian riel depreciated 0.3 percent against the U.S. dollar and was trading at 2,748 to one dollar in April compared to 2,739 to the dollar in March.
